description: This file defines the OpportunitiesParseRule class, which extends BaseRule and is responsible for pre-processing panels in the Opportunities module's detail view by replacing the 'type' column with 'opportunity_type'.

classes.name: OpportunitiesParseRule
classes.description: A class for parsing and modifying panels in the Opportunities detail view in SuiteCRM.
